Role Overview:
 As an Appian Automation Consultant at PradeepIT, you will have the opportunity to expand your knowledge and network in the field of Intelligent Automation. You will work alongside a team of IA enthusiasts, contributing to large-scale automation projects across various industries. This role encompasses the end-to-end automation lifecycle, allowing you to make a significant impact on business processes and digital transformation initiatives.
 Responsibilities:
 Technical:

• Help organizations harness the capabilities of the Appian platform to streamline business processes and drive operational efficiency.

• Participate in the implementation of scaled intelligent automation projects (E2E) using automation technologies such as BluePrism, WorkFusion, or UiPath .

• Possess a solid understanding of integration concepts and patterns, including REST and SOAP.

• Familiarity with authentication concepts, patterns, and protocols such as SSO, SAML, OAuth.

• Demonstrate production experience in at least one programming language (C#, Python, Java).

 Functional:

• Solve complex business problems using a pragmatic approach.

• Understand business process principles and perform detailed business process analysis.

• Produce clear and comprehensive documentation of testing processes and results.

 **Other:**

• Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Drive innovation and contribute to new initiatives within the Intelligent Automation domain.

• Support go-to-market, sales, and proposal activities related to automation solutions.

• Stay updated on emerging trends and technologies in automation and intelligent automation.

 Skills & Qualifications:

• Interest in the broader scope of Intelligent Automation beyond technology.

• Highly enthusiastic, driven, and proactive in approach.

• Ability to guide and collaborate with functional and development teams throughout the project lifecycle.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent proven experience in Intelligent Automation.

• 3 to 5 years of relevant professional experience focused primarily on Intelligent Automation-related topics.

 Join our team at PradeepIT and be part of our journey to revolutionize business processes through Intelligent Automation. Apply now to contribute to cutting-edge projects and drive digital transformation for our global customers.
